name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-castle-pillars
title: Super Mario World - Castle Pillars
description:
With this, you can have parallax scrolling in your castle levels! The castle pillars in the back are now in layer 3. You will have to edit layer 2 a bit to get this looking nice if you want it to look like the original, though.
Credit is not necessary, but I'd like it :)
Released in C3 Winter 2016.
